title: Kodak Ektralite 10 Pocket Film Camera Vintage 1970s Untested 110 Film
categoryName: Cameras & Photo:Vintage Movie & Photography:Vintage Cameras:Other Vintage Cameras
descriptionText: The Kodak Ektralite 10 Pocket Film Camera is a vintage piece from the 1970s, featuring a sleek black design and compact size. Made by Kodak in the United States, this camera utilizes 110 film and is perfect for photography enthusiasts looking for a unique and nostalgic shooting experience. Although untested, this classic camera holds the potential to capture timeless moments with its retro charm and quality craftsmanship. A must-have for collectors of vintage cameras and photography gear.
